purpose: Compare prespecified deterministic changes under the current new-contribution-only numerical contract; establish implementation and historical evidence without selecting or deploying a winning predictive configuration.

scientific_contract.unused_prior_cash: retained and valued but never automatically reoffered
scientific_contract.existing_positions: retained and valued; only owned exclusion may consult identities and quantities
scientific_contract.owned_policy: allow is an explicit study preference; the live default exclusion is a separate scenario
scientific_contract.candidate_source: fixed preselected public universe; not live discovery/provider selection
scientific_contract.overlap_policy: allow; no historical constituent look-through supplied
scientific_contract.horizon: medium; production fixed signal scaffold and one-calendar-year daily history
scientific_contract.information_cutoff: completed previous calendar-month end; each asset uses its last completed observation at or before cutoff
scientific_contract.execution: first common observed session strictly after cutoff among active/incepted universe; fixed causal close-proxy stages: Xetra 17:30 Europe/Berlin, then crypto 23:59:59 UTC; later prices cannot alter earlier fills
scientific_contract.contribution_event: 00:00 UTC on the common execution date; units issued at the previous completed calendar day's NAV before later execution events
scientific_contract.staged_risk_scope: previously filled positions from this same new contribution plus its remaining cash only; previously executed units are immutable and user legacy holdings stay outside decisions
scientific_contract.execution_limitation: daily close proxies with hypothetical charges do not reconstruct intraday executable quotes, broker acknowledgements, partial fills or actual market impact
scientific_contract.unit_contract: filled units never exceed the quote-approved units or principal ceilings; affordable-minimum-lot recovery and final risk checks are retained
scientific_contract.fee_model: explicit hypothetical scenarios, not the user's confirmed broker schedule
scientific_contract.corporate_actions: only retained accumulating funds and crypto; unsupported distributions/splits fail capture
scientific_contract.historical_partition: known chronology, not a pristine holdout or prospective test
scientific_contract.risk_comparison: same ex-ante limits; realized volatility, exposure and drawdowns reported separately, never assumed equal
scientific_contract.minimum_lot_and_cost_interaction: At 1 euro fixed plus 10 bps, a 1 percent cost cap cannot trade a 100 euro contribution under a 45 percent candidate cap; this outcome is expected, retained and not interpreted as predictive skill
scientific_contract.promotion: no predictive production promotion based solely on this known-history study; require independent review and subsequent recorded evidence

source_basis.method: fixed trend comparator and explicit transfer limitations

mandatory_outputs: all predeclared trials including ties and failures
net wealth under identical cash flows
results by period and asset universe
no historical winner selected for production
